description: Shared, cited knowledge-graph memory for agents — ask, search, remember, keep standing instructions
name: io.github.Junemind/june-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Your June endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (the Junê desktop app's local engine, your own june-local service, or a hosted Team workspace)
environmentVariables.name: JUNE_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: The canvas (workspace) to bind this connection to — a name (e.g. 'work') or a canvas id; names resolve at startup and ambiguous names fail closed
environmentVariables.name: JUNE_CANVAS

environmentVariables.description: Your June API key (set JUNE_ALLOW_ANON=1 instead to explicitly opt out for keyless local setups)
environmentVariables.name: JUNE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Bring-your-own LLM key for cited answers — forwarded per-request as a header, never logged or stored on the service
environmentVariables.name: JUNE_LLM_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to create the named canvas on first run if it doesn't exist yet (refused in read-only mode)
environmentVariables.name: JUNE_CANVAS_CREATE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to hide and refuse all write tools (memory becomes read-only)
environmentVariables.name: JUNE_READONLY

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in directory agents may upload files from via june_ingest_file — unset means that tool doesn't exist
environmentVariables.name: JUNE_FILES_ROOT

environmentVariables.description: Canvas holding the agent's standing docs/skills/learnings (default 'agent_docs')
environmentVariables.name: JUNE_DOCS_CANVAS

environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to disable the periodic standing-docs digest re-injected on tool results (default on)
environmentVariables.name: JUNE_DOCS_REFRESH

environmentVariables.description: Tool calls between digest injections (default 12) — lower it for small-context agents
environmentVariables.name: JUNE_REFRESH_CALLS

environmentVariables.description: Standing-docs digest size cap in characters (default 2000)
environmentVariables.name: JUNE_DIGEST_CHARS

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in directory for repo sync — enables june_docs_export / june_page_export / june_page_import (fenced writes, commit-only git); unset means those tools don't exist
environmentVariables.name: JUNE_EXPORT_ROOT

title: Junê
